cards.intuition: Every parent is no larger than its children, so the smallest key rises to the root. Siblings and separate branches need not be sorted.
cards.topic: Binary Heap Mechanics: Insert and Extract-Min

cards.intuition: A complete tree fits compactly in an array, eliminating pointers. Simple arithmetic locates family members.
cards.topic: Binary Heap Mechanics: Insert and Extract-Min

cards.intuition: Insert appends and sifts upward. Extraction replaces the root with the final item and sifts downward. Either travels at most one tree height.
cards.formula: insert O(log n); minimum O(1); extract-min O(log n)
cards.topic: Binary Heap Mechanics: Insert and Extract-Min

cards.intuition: Build a heap by sifting internal nodes downward. Most nodes are near leaves and move little, making total batch construction linear.
cards.topic: Binary Heap Mechanics: Insert and Extract-Min

cards.concept: Bounded min-heap for largest top k
cards.intuition: Keep only winners and place the weakest winner at the root. A newcomer enters only by beating that cutoff.
cards.formula: full heap: if score > root, replace root and sift down; otherwise discard
cards.topic: Maintaining Top-k with a Bounded Min-Heap

cards.intuition: After every processed prefix, the heap contains that prefix's k largest items. Replacing only the weakest winner preserves the claim inductively.
cards.formula: streaming top-k time O(n log k), retained space O(k)
cards.topic: Maintaining Top-k with a Bounded Min-Heap

cards.intuition: Equal scores need a stable secondary key, or arrival and shard timing can change which candidate survives at the boundary.
cards.topic: Maintaining Top-k with a Bounded Min-Heap

cards.intuition: Sorting orders every loser; a bounded heap learns only enough to maintain the cutoff. The saving is largest when k is tiny relative to n.
cards.formula: full sort O(n log n); heap selection O(n log k)
cards.topic: Heap-Based Top-k vs Full Sort: Cost Comparison

cards.intuition: A heap identifies the winner set but does not rank every member. Sort the retained k after selection when the consumer needs descending output.
cards.formula: total = O(n log k + k log k)
cards.topic: Heap-Based Top-k vs Full Sort: Cost Comparison

cards.intuition: Use a heap for streaming and tight memory, quickselect for one mutable in-memory batch, and full sort when the complete order is the actual output.
cards.formula: choose by required order, arrival mode, and memory
